caption: Diagram 2.7 | Examples of Category 2 bathrooms Services and controls
description: This drawing is a floor plan showing two side‑by‑side layouts, labelled "Example 2.7A" (left) and "Example 2.7B" (right), under the caption "Diagram 2.7 Examples of Category 2 bathrooms". Each plan depicts a small room containing a bath along the left wall (with a mixer tap and dashed lines showing the space for a level-access shower), a semicircular wash hand basin with tap at the top centre, and a WC with cistern at the top right. A door at the bottom right is shown as a solid line with a swing arc, plus a dotted alternative door position. Dashed lines and grey shading indicate access zones around the fixtures. Dimensions are given: a horizontal 2150mm across the top of each plan, with a 450mm segment at the top right. The left plan carries a vertical 1900mm dimension; the right plan carries vertical dimensions of 2000mm, 1700mm and 300mm. Below the plans, a "Notes" block reads: 1. Dimensions for illustration purposes only. 2. Stack and drainage positions to be shown clear of access zones where located within WC / Cloakroom. 3. Alternative door positions shown dotted.
